DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 桃はこちらの箱にお入れしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Shall I put the peaches in this box?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 自転車で帰ります。この箱はかごより大きいので、斜めにして入れることになりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自転車のかごに大箱を斜めに載せる不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I am cycling home. This box is larger than my basket, so it looks as though I would have to put it in at an angle.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain your concern about placing the large box at an angle in your bicycle basket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 小さい箱もあります。桃を重ねず、三つ並べて入れられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: We have a smaller box too. It holds three peaches side by side without stacking them.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三つ買うので、小さい方を見せてください。かごの幅は家で測って、ここに書いてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 三個用小箱と測ったかご幅のメモを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I am buying three, so please show me the smaller one. I measured the basket width at home and wrote it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Show the note of your measured basket width and ask about the small box for three peaches. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの箱の幅は二十四センチです。メモの幅は二十八センチですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: This box is twenty-four centimeters wide. Your note says twenty-eight centimeters.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 幅は入りそうです。ふたを閉めた時の高さも知りたいです。かごの上にひもを掛けて運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 箱幅が収まり閉じた高さも尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: The width looks as though it will fit. I would also like to know its height with the lid closed. I will carry it with a cord across the basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say the width fits and ask its height when closed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 高さは八センチです。ひもを強く締めて箱をつぶさないようお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: It is eight centimeters high. Please avoid tightening the cord so hard that it crushes the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 八センチなら載せられそうです。小さい箱に三つ入れてください。自転車のかごには、箱の底を水平にして置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 小箱に桃三個を詰めるよう頼み水平に載せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Eight centimeters should fit. Please put three peaches in the small box. I will place it in the bicycle basket with the bottom level.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask for three peaches in the small box and say you will place it level. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 桃の下と間に緩衝材を入れておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will put cushioning underneath and between the peaches.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。箱の上へ買った飲み物を重ねないようにし、荷物が落ち着いてから自転車を押して出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 飲物を重ねず荷物を整えて自転車を押して出ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. I will avoid stacking the drinks I bought on top of the box and will push my bicycle out once the luggage is settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you will not stack drinks on it, will arrange your luggage, and will push the bicycle out. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: こちらの箱をどうぞ。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Here is your box. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 路面電車に初めてお乗りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is this your first time taking a tram?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。バスと同じように後ろから乗ろうと思いましたが、この車両はどこから乗りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 初利用の車両の乗り口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. I thought I would board at the back like a bus, but where do I board this vehicle?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask where to board this vehicle on your first ride. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの車両は前の扉から乗り、降りる時も前の扉を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: On this vehicle, you board through the front door and use the front door to get off too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 前なのですね。降りる人がいる時は先に待って、乗る順番になってから進みます。お金は乗る時ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 降車者を待つと伝え運賃支払時点を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The front, then. If people are getting off, I will wait first and move forward when it is my turn to board. Do I pay when boarding?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for people getting off and check when to pay the fare. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 降りる時に支払います。乗車時は、車内の読取り機へカードを触れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: You pay when getting off. When boarding, touch your card to the reader inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: カードを使いたいです。乗る時に読み取らせて、降りる時にもう一度触れる、という順番で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: カードの乗車時読取りと降車時支払いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I would like to use a card. Is the sequence to have it read when boarding and touch it again when getting off?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm card reading when boarding and payment when getting off. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。この車両では降車時にも触れてください。分からない時は、止まっている時に運転士へお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. On this vehicle, please touch it when getting off too. If unsure, ask the driver while the vehicle is stopped.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分からなくなったら、停留所で止まっている時に運転士さんへ聞きます。今日はこの表示の方向へ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 停車中に運転士へ尋ねると伝え行きたい方向を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: If I get confused, I will ask the driver while stopped at a tram stop. Today I want to go in the direction on this sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the driver while stopped and indicate your intended direction. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、今ご覧になっている表示の方向です。扉の前では、降りる方を先にお通しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, that is the direction on the sign you are looking at. At the door, let passengers getting off pass first.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 行き先も確認できました。降りる方が通れるよう、少し下がって待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 方向確認後に降車者の通る場所を空けて待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I have confirmed the destination too. I will step back a little and wait so people getting off can pass.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: After confirming the direction, say you will leave space for people getting off and wait. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: それでは、お気をつけて。よいお出かけを。

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 串焼きは、こちらの袋でお持ち帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Will you take the grilled skewers away in this bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。ただ、串の先が袋の端へ出そうです。歩いて持つので、先を覆ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 袋を突きそうな串先を覆う包装を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, but the skewer tips look as though they might poke out through the edge of the bag. I will carry it while walking; could you cover the tips?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request wrapping that covers the skewer tips that might pierce the bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 串ごと入る長い容器へ移して、ふたをします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will move them into a long container that fits the skewers and put a lid on it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その容器でお願いします。持っている布の袋に入れるので、食べ物と串が外へ出ない方が助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 布袋で運ぶためふた付き長容器を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: That container, please. I will put it in my cloth bag, so it would help to keep both the food and skewers from sticking out.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Choose the long lidded container because you will carry it in a cloth bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三本の串は、先が中へ収まっています。ふたが持ち上がる所がないか、一緒にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The tips of all three skewers fit inside. Please check with me that the lid is not lifting anywhere.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三本とも先が中に収まりましたね。ふたも浮いていないので、この容器でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 串先とふたの状態を確かめ容器を了承する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: All three tips are inside now. The lid is not raised either, so I will take this container.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check the skewer tips and lid and approve the container. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ふたを閉めました。底も温かいので、こちらの持ち運び用の袋でお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have closed the lid. The bottom is warm too, so I will hand it over in this carrying bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。布袋の底に入れます。ほかの荷物に押されないよう、上を空けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 布袋の底へ入れ上の荷物で押さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. I will place it at the bottom of my cloth bag and leave room above so other luggage does not press on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will put it at the bottom of your cloth bag without pressing it with items on top. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 傾けると汁が漏れることがありますので、平らにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Liquid may leak if it tilts, so please carry it level.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 横に倒さずに持ちます。袋の持ち手も二本そろえました。これで持って帰れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 傾けず持ち手をそろえて持帰る準備ができたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will carry it without tipping it sideways. I have gathered both bag handles together too. I am ready to take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you are ready to carry it home without tilting it and with both handles together. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: それでは、包みをお渡しします。串先にお気をつけてお帰りください。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Here is your package. Watch the skewer tips on your way home. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 相談に使う通知は、お持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Do you have the notice for today's consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 携帯に届いた通知を見せる予定でしたが、電池が切れました。印刷した控えなら、かばんにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 携帯電池切れで印刷控えを提示できると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I planned to show the notice on my phone, but the battery has died. I do have a printed copy in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say your phone battery is dead but you can show a printed copy. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 印刷した物を拝見します。通知の全体が載っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will look at the printout. Does it include the entire notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二枚あります。最初の一枚だけでなく、問い合わせ先のある二枚目も持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 問い合わせ先を含む二枚の控えを所持すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: There are two sheets. I brought not just the first but also the second sheet with the contact information.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you have both sheets, including the contact information. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二枚ともお出しください。今日確認したいことは、何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please take out both. What would you like to check today?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この通知のどこへ問い合わせればよいか知りたいです。担当の名前が二つあり、どちらか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 通知に担当名が二つあり問い合わせ先が分からないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I want to know which contact in this notice I should ask. There are two people or sections listed as responsible, and I am unsure which one.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that the notice lists two responsible contacts and you do not know whom to ask. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 件名とご質問を見て、どちらの担当への問い合わせか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will check the subject and your question to see which contact it concerns.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。質問はノートにも書いてあるので、通知の控えと一緒に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: ノートの質問も紙通知と合わせて提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. My questions are written in my notebook too, so please look at that together with the notice copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Present your notebook questions together with the paper notice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: このご質問は、二枚目にある問い合わせ担当へのご相談です。こちらの担当名と窓口名をノートへ書き留められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: This question is for the inquiries contact on the second sheet. Could you note this contact name and desk name in your notebook?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい、ノートへ書きます。帰って充電できたら、元の通知と窓口名を見比べてから問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 窓口名を書き自宅で元通知と照合して連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes, I will write them down. Once I get home and charge my phone, I will compare the original notice with the desk name before contacting them.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you will note the desk name, compare it with the original notice at home, and contact them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 二枚目の問い合わせ担当の案内をお渡しします。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will give you the information for the inquiries contact on the second sheet. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 園内で、特にご覧になりたい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is there any part of the park you particularly want to see?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 子どもが鳥の絵を描きたいそうです。スケッチブックを広げて、しばらく立ち止まれる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 鳥を描くため立ち止まれる観察場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: My child wants to draw birds. Is there somewhere we can open a sketchbook and stop for a while?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask for an observation spot where you can stop to draw birds. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 鳥の展示の横に、通路から外れた観察スペースがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Beside the bird exhibit, there is an observation space away from the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 観察スペースへ着いてから道具を出します。子どもの画板を広げても通路にはみ出さないくらいの広さですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 観察場所で画板を広げられる広さを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: We will take out the drawing tools after reaching that space. Is it large enough to open my child's drawing board without sticking out into the walkway?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check whether the observation space has room to open a drawing board. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、画板を使えます。ほかの方もご覧になりますので、譲り合ってお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, you can use a drawing board. Other people will be watching too, so please share the space considerately.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。人が来たら端へ寄ります。子どもが描きやすいよう、私は横でかばんを持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 他客へ場所を譲り自分はかばんを持つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. If people come, we will move to the side. I will stand beside my child and hold the bag so drawing is easier.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will make space for other visitors and hold the bag yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 展示前の案内もご確認ください。動物を動かすために音を出すことはお控えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please also check the information in front of the exhibit. Refrain from making sounds to make the animals move.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 子どもには、今見えている姿を描くように話します。鳥が奥へ行ったら、戻ってくるのを静かに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 鳥を静かに観察し見える姿を描くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will tell my child to draw the bird as it appears now. If it goes farther back, we will wait quietly for it to return.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will observe the birds quietly and draw the pose you can see. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 絵が終わりましたら、道具をまとめてから次の展示へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: When the drawing is finished, please pack the tools before moving to the next exhibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい。紙と鉛筆をかばんへ戻してから歩きます。今日はその鳥の展示から見学を始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 絵道具収納後に歩き鳥展示から始めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes. We will put the paper and pencils back in the bag before walking. Today we will start our visit at that bird exhibit.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you will put the drawing tools away before walking and start with the bird exhibit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: それでは、親子で観察をお楽しみください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Enjoy observing together with your child. Have a lovely visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 前髪は、どのくらいの長さをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: How long would you like your bangs?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 普段より少し短くしたいです。仕事でこの帽子をかぶると、前髪が押されて目に入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 仕事帽子で前髪が目へ下がるため短くしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: A little shorter than usual. When I wear this hat for work, it presses my bangs down into my eyes.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you want shorter bangs because your work hat pushes them down into your eyes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 帽子をかぶった時の様子を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Could you show me what it looks like with the hat on?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: かぶりました。横は耳の上に収まりますが、前だけ下がってきます。全部を短くしたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 帽子着用を示し前だけで横後ろは希望しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have put it on. The sides stay above my ears, but only the front falls down. I do not want everything cut short.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Show yourself wearing the hat and explain you want only the front shortened, not the sides or back. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 前の長さを中心に相談しましょう。帽子を外して、まず少しだけ切って確認する方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let us focus on the front length. One option is to take the hat off, cut just a little first, and check.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その方法でお願いします。一度に大きく切らず、途中で帽子をかぶって見直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 少し切る途中で帽子をかぶり直したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: That way, please. Rather than cut a lot at once, I would like to put the hat back on partway through and check again.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to have a little cut and try the hat back on during the haircut. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 切った髪を払ってから、帽子でご確認いただきます。今日は前髪のカットのみで、料金は五百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: We will brush off the cut hair before you check with the hat. Today is a bangs-only cut, costing five hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 五百円の前髪カットでお願いします。横と後ろは変えず、仕事中に前が邪魔にならないよう相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 五百円の前髪のみで横後ろ維持と注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: The five-hundred-yen bangs cut, please. I want to discuss keeping the front out of the way at work while leaving the sides and back unchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Order only the five-hundred-yen bangs cut, keeping the sides and back unchanged. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。帽子はそのままお持ちください。担当の美容師にもご希望を伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. Please keep the hat with you. I will tell the hairstylist your wishes too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。最初に残す長さを鏡で確認したいことも、担当の方へ伝えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 切る前に鏡で残す長さを確認する希望の引継ぎを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. Could you also tell them I want to check the length to leave in the mirror before we start?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Ask them to pass on your wish to check the remaining length in the mirror before cutting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 長さの確認もお伝えします。奥のお席へどうぞ。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will tell them about checking the length too. Please take a seat farther inside. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 熱い鉄板のお料理をお持ちしました。こちらへ置いてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here is your dish on a hot iron plate. May I put it here?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 写真を撮ろうとして携帯を前へ出していました。先に置いていただけるよう、携帯とグラスをよけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 撮影携帯とグラスをよけ熱い鉄板の置場を空ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I had moved my phone forward to take a photo. I will move the phone and glass aside so you can put it down first.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Move your camera phone and glass aside to make space for the hot plate. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 手を離してお待ちください。こちらの敷物の上へ置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Keep your hands away while you wait. I will put it on this mat.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 手を引きました。敷物の上を空けておいたので、そこへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 手を引き敷物の上の置場を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have pulled my hands back. I have cleared the top of the mat, so please put it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Pull your hands back and indicate the space on the mat. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 鉄板も取っ手も熱いので、位置を変えたい時はお呼びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: The plate and handle are hot, so call us if you want its position changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二人で食べやすい位置にしたいです。私の側へ持つのではなく、少し真ん中へ寄せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分で持たず店員へ中央移動を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I would like a position that makes it easy for two people to eat. Instead of lifting it toward me, could you move it a little toward the middle?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to move it toward the center rather than lifting it yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらで動かしました。この位置でいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have moved it. How is this position?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この位置なら二人とも届きます。ここに座ったまま写真を撮ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二人で届く配置を確認し着席したままの撮影可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Both of us can reach it here. May I take a photograph while staying seated here?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check that both can reach and ask whether you can take a photo while seated. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、そのまま撮っていただけます。取り分けには、こちらの道具をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, you may photograph it as you are. Please use these utensils to serve portions.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 写真を撮れました。携帯をしまい、頂いた道具で取り分けます。友人にも鉄板に手を触れないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 撮影後携帯をしまい道具で取分け友人にも熱さを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: I have taken the photo. I will put my phone away and use the utensils you gave me to serve it. I will also tell my friend not to touch the hot plate.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: After photographing, put the phone away, serve using utensils, and tell your friend it is hot too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: それでは、熱さにお気をつけて。どうぞお料理をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please be careful of the heat. Enjoy your meal.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 測定の報告に「十二」とありますが、何を測った値でしょうか。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your measurement report says “twelve.” What does that measurement refer to?

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部品の長さです。数字だけ伝えてしまいました。ミリメートルで十二という意味です。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 報告の十二は部品の長さ十二ミリメートルと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-02.translation: The length of the part. I gave only the number. I meant twelve millimeters.
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the reported twelve means the part's length is twelve millimeters. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 長さを測った箇所も、記録から分かるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please make the measured location clear from the record too.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 端から端までではなく、この穴の内側です。図の丸を付けた部分を測りました。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 端全体ではなく図で丸を付けた穴の内側と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is not from end to end, but the inside of this hole. I measured the part circled on the diagram.
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that it is the hole's inside circled on the diagram, not the full end-to-end length. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、図の丸と測定欄を対応させましょう。測定器に表示された値は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us link the circle on the diagram to the measurement field. Do you still have the value shown on the measuring instrument?

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 測定直後に書いたメモがあります。「十二・〇ミリ」と書いていました。報告で小数のゼロも省いています。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元メモの十二・〇ミリと口頭で省いたゼロを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a note I wrote immediately after measuring. I wrote “12.0 millimeters.” I also omitted the decimal zero in my report.
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the original note's 12.0 millimeters and explain the zero you omitted orally. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 元のメモを見ながら、測定値と単位を記入してください。判定欄はまだ空欄ですね。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please enter the measurement and unit while looking at the original note. The judgment field is still blank, correct?

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。測れたことと合格したことは別なので、判定は書いていません。担当に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 測定と合否を区別して判定欄は未記入と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Taking a measurement and passing are separate matters, so I have not entered a judgment. I would like the person in charge to check.
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish measuring from pass/fail and say the judgment field is blank. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へこの図と記録を渡します。口頭でも、何を測ったかから説明してください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will give this diagram and record to the person in charge. When explaining orally too, start with what you measured.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 穴の内側を測り、記録した値は十二・〇ミリメートルです、と伝えます。数字だけの報告を直してから渡します。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 測定箇所と単位付き数値から担当へ説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will say, “I measured the inside of the hole, and the recorded value is 12.0 millimeters.” I will correct the number-only report before handing it over.
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the measured location and number with its unit to the person in charge. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: これで報告の対象が分かります。それでは、担当の確認を待ちましょう。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOTA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Now we can tell what the report refers to. Let us wait for the person in charge to check. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 大きなお洗濯物ですね。お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: That is a large item of laundry. Do you need help?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: シーツの端が床に付きそうです。畳む間、こちらの台へ広げてもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 床に触れそうなシーツを台で畳んでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The edge of the sheet is about to touch the floor. May I spread it on this table while folding it?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can fold the sheet on the table because it might touch the floor. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは洗濯物を畳むための台です。今は空いていますので、どうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a table for folding laundry. It is free now, so please use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 助かります。かばんも台に置くと場所が足りないので、私の椅子へ移してから広げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 台を空けるためかばんを自分の椅子へ移すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: That helps. If I put my bag on it too, there will not be enough room, so I will move it to my chair before spreading the sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will move your bag to your own chair to clear the table. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使い終えた物だけを置いてください。シーツは乾燥を終えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please only put items that have finished being used on it. Has your sheet finished drying?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、乾燥が終わった私のシーツです。ほかの人の物は持ってきていません。まず長い辺を合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乾燥済みの自己シーツのみを広げると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, it is my sheet and it has finished drying. I have not brought anyone else's items. I will start by matching the long edges.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you are spreading only your own dried sheet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 後ろの通路は、人が通れるよう空けておいてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the walkway behind you clear for people to pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 台の手前に立ちます。反対側へ回ろうとすると通路に出るので、こちら側から少しずつ畳みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路へ出ず台の手前から畳むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will stand on this side of the table. Going around to the other side would put me in the walkway, so I will fold it gradually from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will fold from the near side without entering the walkway. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 台へ置いた小物も、最後に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check any small items you put on the table at the end too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: シーツをかばんへ入れました。台に残した洗濯ばさみも取りました。椅子のかばんを持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 収納済みシーツと洗濯ばさみと椅子のかばんを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have put the sheet in my bag. I have taken the clothespins I left on the table too. I will take the bag from my chair and go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the packed sheet, clothespins, and bag on the chair. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 台を空けてくださってありがとうございます。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for clearing the table. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 輪の切れている方向を、教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you tell me which direction the gap in the ring faces?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 切れ目は見えますが、右と左を日本語で言う時に迷います。見えないという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切れ目は見えるが日本語の右左で迷うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can see the gap, but I get confused saying right and left in Japanese. I do not mean that I cannot see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you see the gap but are unsure of the Japanese words for right and left. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 言葉の方向で迷われるのですね。どちらだと思うか、手で示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it is the words for directions that confuse you. Could you indicate which direction you think it is with your hand?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。自分の体の右側を指しています。「右」で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の右を指し日本語の右との一致を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This way. I am pointing to the right side of my body. Is “migi” correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to your own right and ask whether it matches the Japanese word “migi.” Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、右です。次も手で示していただいて結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, that is right. You may indicate the next one with your hand too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。次の小さい輪は、切れ目自体が分かりません。今度は言葉ではなく、見え方のことです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次の小さい輪は言語でなく切れ目自体が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I cannot make out the gap itself in the next smaller ring. This time it is about my vision, not language.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that for the next small ring, the gap itself is unclear, rather than the language. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からない時は、そのようにお伝えください。別の大きさで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you do not know, please say so. We will check using another size.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分からないのに右か左を選ばず、見えた時だけ指で示します。もう一度お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見えない時は推測せず見える時だけ指すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not choose right or left when I cannot tell, and will point only when I can see it. Please try again.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not guess when you cannot see and will point only when you can. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの輪は、いかがですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今の輪は上に切れ目が見えます。上を指します。方向の言葉も一つずつ覚えながら答えられそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次の輪の上の切れ目を言葉と指で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can see a gap at the top of this ring. I will point upward. I think I can answer while learning the direction words one at a time too.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Indicate the next ring's top gap with both words and your finger. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 上の切れ目が見えると確認できました。続きの検査を担当する方にも、言葉では迷う時があると伝えてお呼びします。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed you can see the gap at the top. I will also tell the person doing the rest of the test that you sometimes have trouble with the words, and call them. Excuse me.
